Comedian Samay Raina's joke about Varun Dhawan leads to online debate

Comedian Samay Raina made a joke about actor Varun Dhawan during an episode of 'India's Got Latent' Season 2, stating Dhawan still struggles to perform in Gujarat despite trying and has three FIRs against him. Dhawan reportedly called the joke 'most inappropriate'. The episode also featured actor Medha Shankr, with clips of the show going viral online. Dhawan appeared as a guest judge alongside comedians Sharon Verma and Nishant Verma.
